Thousands of years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched an '''anti-slavery campaign''' within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. As part of that campaign, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] serving the Republic especially targeted the notorious [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], which resulted in a brutal [[Jedi–Zygerrian conflict/Legends|Jedi–Zygerrian conflict]] that ended with the complete defeat of the Zygerrians.
